# Instagram errors

Instagram codes share numbers with WhatsApp codes but not their meaning: read a Instagram message's code here, never in the WhatsApp files. The MCP tools send on WhatsApp only, so these come up when the person asks about a message sent from the inbox.

| Code | Title | Meaning | How to fix | Who fixes it | Retry helps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `4` | Instagram rate limit | Instagram rate-limited this app or account. | Wait a moment and retry. Do not send the same message repeatedly. | Meta | no |
| `190` | Instagram connection lost | Instagram no longer accepts this account's access: the token expired or the owner turned off access to messages. | Reconnect the Instagram account in Settings, Channels, then retry. | Meta | no |
| `551` | Instagram user unavailable | The customer cannot receive messages from this account right now. | Do not keep retrying. The customer may have blocked the account or restricted messages. | Meta | no |
| `613` | Instagram rate limit | Instagram rate-limited this app or account. | Wait a moment and retry. Do not send the same message repeatedly. | Meta | no |
| `1545041` | Instagram user unavailable | The customer cannot receive messages from this account right now. | Do not keep retrying. The customer may have blocked the account or restricted messages. | Meta | no |
| `2018001` | No matching Instagram user | Instagram did not find the customer this reply was addressed to. | Do not retry. The customer's account may have been deleted or deactivated. | Meta | no |
| `2018008` | Instagram could not fetch the file | Instagram could not download the attachment from the link we gave it, or the upload never answered. | Send the file again. If it keeps failing, check that the backend's public address is reachable. | Meta | no |
| `2018047` | Instagram refused the attachment | Instagram could not process the file, often because its type does not match its contents. | Send a JPG, PNG or GIF image, an MP4 video, an M4A or AAC audio file, or a PDF. | Meta | no |
| `2018108` | Instagram user unavailable | The customer cannot receive messages from this account right now. | Do not keep retrying. The customer may have blocked the account or restricted messages. | Meta | no |
| `2018109` | Instagram attachment too large | The file is larger than Instagram accepts for its type (8 MB for images, 25 MB for video, audio and PDFs). | Send a smaller file. | Meta | no |
| `2018278` | Outside the Instagram reply window | Instagram accepts a reply only within 24 hours of the customer's last message, or up to 7 days for a reply a person typed. | Wait for the customer to write again, then reply. | Meta | no |
| `2018294` | Instagram video timed out | Instagram did not finish fetching the video within its 75-second limit, or the video is corrupt. | Send the video again, or send a shorter or smaller one. | Meta | no |
| `2534014` | No matching Instagram user | Instagram did not find the customer this reply was addressed to. | Do not retry. The customer's account may have been deleted or deactivated. | Meta | no |
